schemes.title: U-GO Scholarship Program 2026-27
schemes.description: An initiative designed to provide financial assistance to talented young women pursuing professional undergraduate courses such as teaching, nursing, pharmacy, medicine, engineering, architecture, and law.
required_documents: Mark sheets and passing certificates of class 10 and 12
Government-issued identity proof (Voter ID, Driving Licence, PAN card, etc.)
Current year admission proof (fee receipt, admission letter, ID card, or bonafide certificate)
Family income proof (ITR, Form 16, income certificate, or salary slips)
Payment receipts for funds spent on academic purposes
prerequisites: Must be a young woman enrolled in any year (except final year) of a professional graduation course
Must have secured at least 70% marks in both Class 10 and Class 12 examinations
